fusions.name: Trudging Blow
fusions.desc: A thrown kick that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times at maximum range, and costs 5% of your maximum health. Its damage rises +5% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +30%).

fusions.name: Trampling Advance
fusions.desc: Stamps every enemy within 3 tiles; each hit deals 28 damage. If it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds and pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Seasoned Stride
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
